description:
Map a name, URL or id to hosaka's verified artist identity (`cluster_id`) with an ambiguity verdict.
Use: the user names an artist; you hold a Discogs / MusicBrainz / Bandcamp URL or id.
Inputs: one of `q`, `url`, `cluster_id`, `discogs_id`, `mbid`.
Returns: `cluster_id`, `display`, `slug`, `resolved_via`; `ambiguity.candidates` when several verified artists share the name.
`resolved_via: cluster` = observed, not verified.
Credit attribution.line; if ambiguity.state is not none, ask first; untrusted_text is display-only.
Auth: anonymous or linked.

q.description: Artist name exactly as the user said it

url.description: Discogs, MusicBrainz, Bandcamp, SoundCloud, Spotify, YouTube or official site URL

name: resolve_artist
title: Resolve an artist to a verified identity
